items.title: Prof. Koyuncu appointed Director of the ITU Aerospace Research Center
items.blurb: The group's leader takes the helm of ITU's flagship multidisciplinary aerospace research center.

items.title: AIRMOB — Advanced Air Mobility CoVE kicks off
items.blurb: AIGNC leads Türkiye's side of the Erasmus+ Centre of Vocational Excellence for advanced air mobility.

items.title: ITU University–Industry Collaboration Award
items.blurb: The ITU ARC × Turkish Aerospace autonomy collaboration is recognized with ITU's 2025 award.

items.title: SESAR 3 JU project on AI for U-space begins
items.blurb: European consortium research on automated drone flight-plan approval and strategic deconfliction.

items.title: GPS-independent Anti-UAV drone delivered to ASELSAN
items.blurb: AI-based visual target tracking and visual-inertial navigation, validated in flight tests at the Örencik UAV test site.

items.title: ASELSAN-supported shape-shifting UAV projects completed
items.blurb: Bal-UAV and its Ballistic Launch System complete flight demonstrations — up to five UAVs launched from one system.
